title: Distribution Agreement

issues.quote: [format]
issues.why: Body font is Times New Roman throughout; house rule 9 requires Aptos.
issues.fix: Set all text to 12-point Aptos.

issues.quote: [format]
issues.why: Body paragraphs are justified; house rule 9 bars justified text.
issues.fix: Left-align all paragraphs.

issues.quote: This Distribution Agreement (this "Agreement") is dated this ___ day of ____________, 2027, and is between Harrow Valley Foods, Inc., a Wisconsin corporation (the "Supplier"), and Blue Ridge Provisions LLC, a North Carolina limited liability company (the "Distributor").
issues.why: "this ___ day of" date format (house rule 7).
issues.fix: This agreement is dated [Month Day], 2027, and is between ...

issues.quote: This Distribution Agreement (this "Agreement") is dated this ___ day of ____________, 2027, and is between Harrow Valley Foods, Inc., a Wisconsin corporation (the "Supplier"), and Blue Ridge Provisions LLC, a North Carolina limited liability company (the "Distributor").
issues.why: Document-wide: both party names are defined and used with "the" (the Supplier, the Distributor). House rule 11.
issues.fix: Define ("Supplier") and ("Distributor") and drop "the" throughout: Supplier shall ..., Distributor shall ...

issues.quote: WHEREAS, the Supplier manufactures packaged cheese and other dairy products (the "Products"); and
issues.why: WHEREAS recitals (both paragraphs).
issues.fix: Delete WHEREAS; if background is needed, state it in plain sentences under a Background heading.

issues.quote: NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants herein and other good and valuable consideration, the parties hereto agree as follows:
issues.why: Archaic lead-in: NOW, THEREFORE; herein; good and valuable consideration; hereto.
issues.fix: Delete; use "The parties agree as follows:"

issues.quote: 1.1 The Supplier grants the Distributor the exclusive right to distribute the Products in the Territory.
issues.why: MSCD-style 1.1 numbering throughout (house rule 3).
issues.fix: Sections A., B., C. ...; subsections 1., 2., 3.

issues.quote: The Distributor shall use its best efforts to promote and sell the Products throughout the Territory.
issues.why: "best efforts" (MSCD ch. 8).
issues.fix: Distributor shall use reasonable efforts to promote ...

issues.anchor: term of this Agreement shall be
issues.quote: The term of this Agreement shall be three (3) years, beginning on the date of this Agreement.
issues.why: No duty imposed; language of policy.
issues.fix: The term of this agreement is 3 years, beginning on the date of this agreement.

issues.quote: The term of this Agreement shall be three (3) years, beginning on the date of this Agreement.
issues.why: Words with digits (house rule 2).
issues.fix: 3 years

issues.quote: The Distributor shall purchase the Products at the prices in the price list attached hereto as Exhibit A.
issues.why: "attached hereto" (house rule 6).
issues.fix: at the prices in Schedule A.

issues.quote: EXHIBIT A
issues.why: A price list is information the body refers to, so it belongs in a schedule, not an exhibit (and an exhibit would take a number).
issues.fix: Move it to Schedule A, placed before the exhibits.

issues.quote: The Distributor shall pay each invoice no later than thirty (30) days after the invoice date by wire transfer to the Supplier's account at Fifth Third Bank.
issues.why: Words with digits.
issues.fix: 30 days

issues.quote: If the Distributor shall fail to pay any invoice when due, the Supplier may suspend shipments until the Distributor pays all overdue amounts.
issues.why: "shall" in a condition.
issues.fix: If Distributor fails to pay any invoice when due, ...

issues.quote: EXHIBIT B
issues.why: Lettered exhibit; exhibits take numbers (house rule 6). The form of purchase order is correctly an exhibit.
issues.fix: Exhibit 1 (Form of Purchase Order), after the schedule.

issues.quote: The Supplier will deliver the Products FOB the Supplier's plant in Sheboygan, Wisconsin.
issues.why: "will" used to impose a duty on a party.
issues.fix: Supplier shall deliver the Products FOB ...

issues.quote: The Distributor agrees to indemnify the Supplier against all third-party claims arising out of the Distributor's storage or resale of the Products.
issues.why: "agrees to" instead of language of obligation.
issues.fix: Distributor shall indemnify Supplier against ...

issues.quote: Neither party shall assign this Agreement without the other party's written consent.
issues.why: "shall" with a negative subject reads as "neither party has a duty to assign" (house rule 8).
issues.fix: Neither party may assign this agreement without the other party's written consent.

issues.quote: Headings are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.
issues.why: Headings-for-convenience clause; house rule 4 requires deleting or limiting it because the contract refers to provisions by heading.
issues.fix: Delete it.

issues.quote: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have executed this Agreement as of the date first above written.
issues.why: Archaic concluding clause: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, hereto, executed, date first above written.
issues.fix: The parties are signing this agreement on the date stated in the introductory clause.

traps.quote: The Distributor shall pay each invoice no later than thirty (30) days after the invoice date by wire transfer to the Supplier's account at Fifth Third Bank.
traps.why_correct: Real bank name; the number words are part of a proper name (house rule 2).

traps.quote: The parties shall cooperate with one another in any recall of the Products.
traps.why_correct: "one another" is a pronoun; keep the word (house rule 2).

traps.quote: A party giving notice under this Agreement shall send the notice by certified mail or first-class mail to the other party's address on the signature page.
traps.why_correct: Fixed term; keep the word (house rule 2).

traps.quote: The Supplier represents and warrants that the Products comply with all federal and state food-safety laws.
traps.why_correct: Other side's draft: house rule 10 says keep "represents and warrants". A comment suggesting the remedies-neutral "states" is fine; flagging it as an error or rewriting it is a false positive.

notes: Other side's draft. Party-article and 1.1 enumeration are document-wide and anchored at the 1st occurrence. The WHEREAS issue covers both recital paragraphs. Exhibit A is a misclassified price list (should be Schedule A); Exhibit B is a correctly classified form with a wrong (lettered) label. Section 2.2 and the notice clause are clean. Sentence spacing is 2 spaces throughout (most paragraphs are single sentences).
